notes.title: New Demo, New Trailer, Monster Taming Direct!
notes.content:
Hello!

Lots of progress has been made during development of Pry Into The Void, and I believe I needed a new demo that reflected those improvements!

Previously the demo had reported issues with running on Steam Deck, I am glad to announce that those issues have been squashed! Please enjoy the demo on your Steam Deck in all its glory!

Furthermore, the demo just exudes general polish, and new features such as Battle Challenges. Every battle provides a random challenge which rewards you with items, money or experience!
This adds an extra dimension to your mundane regular JRPG battles while providing an extra challenge to your bosses!


The demo also adds an extra key cutscene that provides more character depth to the start of the game!
The new demo is available to download and play now, so please enjoy!

Pry Into The Void also once again participated in Monster Taming Direct, a yearly showcase of monster taming games that is now 3 years in the running.
You can check out the archive of the event here:
[previewyoutube=Bjca8IIu0YQ;full][/previewyoutube]

We participated with a new trailer showing new monsters and new scenes.
Check it out here:
[previewyoutube=DtbB6CkVAuA;full][/previewyoutube]

Anyways, development is slowly getting there. Not too much left to go.
Seriously, thank you to everyone who has supported the project this far!
See you in the depths of the Void.

- Ernest Placido
